- After every intaeraction, summarize the last interaction, including the user prompt and all steps taken.
- Write this summary to `.copilot/context.md`, replacing any previous summary so that only one summary exists at a time.
- The summary must be updated after every interaction, without exception.
- The summary should be concise, clear, and include both the user prompt and a step-by-step outline of actions taken.
